ee07b2a531c1f05f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة بخت الجزيرة للمقاولات عن أخصائي بيئي للانضمام إلى فريقها في القصيم. يتولى الأخصائي البيئي الإشراف الفني على مشاريع مكافحة آفات الصحة العامة، بما في ذلك تخطيط برامج مكافحة القوارض والحشرات ومتابعة تنفيذها. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى توفير بيئة صحية وآمنة وخالية من الآفات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تخطيط برامج مكافحة آفات الصحة العامة (القوارض، الحشرات، الزواحف) والإشراف على تنفيذها. إجراء مسوحات ميدانية دورية لتحديد مواقع الإصابة وأنواع الآفات ومستوى انتشارها. إعداد جداول العمل اليومية والأسبوعية والشهرية ومتابعة الالتزام بها. الإشراف على فنيي المكافحة والعمال، وتوزيع المهام بينهم، ومتابعة أدائهم. اختيار المبيدات المعتمدة وتحديد الجرعات المناسبة، والتأكد من استخدامها بشكل آمن وفقاً لاشتراطات الصحة والسلامة. متابعة استلام المبيدات والمواد وتخزينها وصرفها حسب اشتراطات السلامة. تقييم نتائج أعمال المكافحة واقتراح الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. استقبال البلاغات والملاحظات من الجهة المستفيدة والتعامل معها في وقتها. كتابة التقارير الفنية الدورية وتجهيز المستخلصات الشهرية للمشروع. التنسيق مع ممثل الجهة المشرفة وحضور الاجتماعات والجولات التفتيشية. التأكد من التزام العمال بأدوات الوقاية الشخصية وإجراءات السلامة. حفظ سجلات العمل والمبيدات المستخدمة والمواقع التي تمت معالجتها. تطوير السياسات والمعايير البيئية إعداد الاستراتيجيات والسياسات والتعليمات والإجراءات المتعلقة برقابة البيئة وحمايتها، مثل استراتيجيات معالجة المياه المنزلية والصناعية وسياسات التخلص من النفايات، ومتابعة اعتمادها وتنفيذها. دراسة وتحديد وإعداد المعايير والمواصفات الوطنية المتعلقة برقابة البيئة وحمايتها، مثل ملوثات الهواء والماء والتربة، ومستويات الإشعاع، وطبقة الأوزون، والتغير المناخي. إعداد مواصفات الأجهزة المستخدمة في الرقابة البيئية وحماية البيئة، مثل أجهزة قياس تلوث الهواء والماء والإشعاعات، ومتابعة توفيرها وتشغيلها والتأكد من جاهزيتها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال البيئي. إعداد التقارير والتوثيق إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بحماية البيئة والنتائج المتوصل إليها. عرض وتوضيح هذه التقارير وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال بيئي ذي صلة. معرفة قوية ببرامج مكافحة آفات الصحة العامة (القوارض، الحشرات، الزواحف). فهم لاشتراطات الصحة والسلامة المتعلقة باستخدام وتخزين المبيدات. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية والمستخلصات الشهرية. مهارات التنسيق والتواصل الفعال مع الجهات المشرفة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في القصيم. يتطلب العمل الميداني والإشراف المباشر على الفرق الفنية لضمان تنفيذ المهام بفعالية وأمان.

eeff2736c850c28d.description: About the Role SNC-Lavalin Fayez Engineering is seeking a Planning & Reporting Manager to lead project planning, scheduling, controls, and performance reporting for a significant infrastructure and landscape project in Riyadh. This full-time role is central to developing integrated schedules, monitoring project performance, and delivering accurate insights to support decision-making and project delivery. Key Responsibilities Lead the development and maintenance of integrated project schedules, encompassing design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and handover activities. Manage project reporting processes, ensuring timely delivery of accurate progress reports, dashboards, KPIs, and management presentations. Monitor project performance against schedule baselines to identify trends, risks, and recovery opportunities. Coordinate with project teams, consultants, and contractors for data gathering, validation, and analysis. Develop forecasting models and provide schedule impact assessments to support project decision-making. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related discipline. Minimum of 15 years of experience in planning, project controls, and reporting on major infrastructure and landscape projects. Extensive experience with Primavera P6, project controls systems, reporting tools, and dashboard solutions. Strong understanding of scheduling methodologies, earned value management, cost and schedule performance analysis, and risk management. Experience delivering large-scale projects within the Middle East, with a preference for experience in Saudi Arabia. Professional certifications such as PMP, PSP (Planning & Scheduling Professional), or equivalent are highly desirable. Required Skills Excellent analytical, presentation, and communication skills. Demonstrated stakeholder management abilities. Ability to manage large datasets, project metrics, and reporting requirements across complex projects. Work Environment This role is based in Riyadh and involves working on a major infrastructure and landscape project. The position requires a professional capable of operating within a dynamic project environment, collaborating with various teams and external stakeholders.

The role oversees curriculum delivery, teaching quality, student progress, and staff development. The Vice Principal will also manage day-to-day academic operations, ensure compliance with accreditation and school standards, and work with staff and families to support student achievement, wellbeing, and safeguarding. Key Responsibilities: Academic Leadership & Strategic Planning: Lead academic programmes in line with the school's vision and objectives. Teaching & Learning Excellence: Ensure effective curriculum delivery, teaching quality and academic standards. Staff Leadership & Development: Manage staff performance, recruitment, retention, appraisal and professional development. Student Achievement & Progress: Monitor student performance, learning outcomes and academic progress. Quality Assurance & Compliance: Ensure compliance with curriculum standards, accreditation requirements and school policies. School Operations & Resource Management: Oversee daily academic operations, staffing, facilities, scheduling and resources. Student Safeguarding & Stakeholder Engagement: Ensure student welfare and safety while maintaining effective stakeholder relationships. Profile Requirements: Education & Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Education or a related field, with a recognised teaching qualification. A Master's in Educational Leadership is an advantage. Middle East Experience: Minimum 3 years of school leadership experience in the Middle East. This is a mandatory requirement. Academic & Curriculum Knowledge: Practical experience with international curricula, teaching standards, student assessment and curriculum development. Leadership & School Improvement: Proven ability to lead academic teams, implement school improvement initiatives and manage change effectively. Staff Management & Development: Experience in staff supervision, performance appraisal, professional development and building effective teaching teams. Operational & Organisational Skills: Ability to manage academic systems, school operations, staffing and scheduling efficiently. Communication & Personal Attributes: Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with an approachable, ethical and flexible leadership style. Accommodation Allowance : 25% of basic salary per month. Transportation Allowance : 10% of basic salary per month. Medical Insurance : Coverage for the employee and family members. Air Ticket : Annual round-trip ticket for the employee only. Tuition Fee Discount : 50% for the first child and 25% for additional children.

ee04338068ae3708.description: About Rize Rize is a rent-now-pay-later platform operating in Saudi Arabia, focused on making renting more accessible and affordable for tenants, and securing income for landlords. The company aims to innovate within the real estate sector by providing financial management solutions for rentals. Rize operates from an office in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, with a diverse team. Role Summary The Head of Marketing will be responsible for all marketing functions at Rize, covering brand, product marketing, acquisition, broker and partner marketing, and engagement and retention. This role involves defining the positioning of Rize and its products, generating demand, and converting marketing investments into measurable business outcomes focused on growth and healthy margins. This is a full-time position requiring over 10 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Develop and own the marketing strategy and annual plan, including budget allocation across products, segments, cities, channels, and online/offline activities. Define Rize’s brand positioning and messaging for tenants, landlords, brokers, and corporate partners, ensuring consistency across all touchpoints. Lead awareness and preference campaigns through content, PR, social media, creators, and events. Manage acquisition across direct, broker, property platform, and corporate channels, tracking acquisition cost, payback, and contribution margin by source. Build and implement a broker and partner marketing program to convert registered brokers into active, repeat partners, including joint marketing initiatives. Drive active usage through onboarding, lifecycle, referral, and reactivation campaigns, and manage retention and renewal communications. Oversee positioning and launch plans for new products within a unified brand, and drive cross-selling efforts. Develop launch plans for new cities. Establish reliable measurement frameworks with Data and Finance teams, presenting results and recommendations to leadership regularly. Assess, build, and lead the marketing team, and manage external agencies against defined objectives. Qualifications and Experience Saudi national. Minimum of 8 years in marketing, with at least 3 years in a leadership role managing teams and budgets. Demonstrated growth results in Saudi Arabia within fintech, proptech, consumer finance, e-commerce, digital platforms, or similar sectors. Experience combining brand building with measurable customer acquisition, including a strong understanding of acquisition economics, lifecycle management, retention, and lifetime value. Product marketing and launch experience, including investment allocation across a portfolio. Experience in B2C marketing, complemented by B2B or partner-led marketing. Proven ability to improve activation, active usage, or repeat engagement for digital products. Capability to collaborate with Data and Finance teams on measurement and investment decisions. Fluent in both Arabic and English. Company Values Innovation: A technology-driven approach focused on uplifting the real estate sector. Customer Centricity: Prioritizing the customer in all decisions and actions. Adaptability: Ability to respond quickly to changing market conditions and customer needs. Empowerment & Collaboration: Valuing team contributions, respecting ideas, and fostering autonomy and collaboration. Ethical Excellence: Operating within the highest ethical standards.

ee1fddd56e80cf9a.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المعمر لأنظمة المعلومات عن مدير عمليات تشغيل للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يشارك شاغل هذا الدور في إعداد الخطط الاستراتيجية والتشغيلية لعمليات التشغيل، ويشرف بشكل مباشر على تخطيط وتنظيم تشغيل المعدات المختلفة. يهدف الدور إلى ضمان سير العمليات بأقصى قدر من الكفاءة والفعالية، مع توفير كافة الموارد التقنية والبشرية اللازمة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المشاركة في إعداد الخطط الاستراتيجية والأهداف العامة بما يتماشى مع التوجهات والأولويات المحددة، والمساهمة في إدارة وتوجيه وتقييم عمليات التطبيق. متابعة وإدارة وتوجيه الأنشطة المتعلقة بتشغيل المعدات، وضمان التطبيق الأمثل للأنظمة واللوائح والتعليمات. متابعة عمليات إصدار التراخيص والتصاريح بما يتوافق مع المعايير والشروط المعتمدة. المشاركة في مراجعة وتطوير الأنظمة واللوائح والسياسات المتبعة في مجالات تشغيل المعدات لضمان تحديثها المستمر. مراجعة ودراسة احتياجات المملكة من الخطوط الحديدية فيما يتعلق بالمعدات. متابعة عمليات إعداد وتحضير تقارير العمل والإنجاز، وعرضها على الإدارة العليا، وإحاطتها بالتحديات والمستجدات المتعلقة بتشغيل المعدات. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال ذي صلة بعمليات التشغيل. القدرة على المشاركة في إعداد الخطط الاستراتيجية والتشغيلية. فهم عميق لعمليات تخطيط وتنظيم تشغيل المعدات المختلفة. القدرة على ضمان توافر الموارد التقنية والبشرية اللازمة لسير العمليات. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. تتطلب بيئة العمل التعاون مع فرق متعددة والإشراف المباشر على الأنشطة التشغيلية لضمان تحقيق الأهداف المحددة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة لم يتم الإفصاح عنه.

ee487cf32891eb09.description: About Abdul Latif Jameel Abdul Latif Jameel is a diversified business comprising independent entities involved in automotive distribution, auto parts manufacturing, financial services, renewable energy, environmental services, health, land and real estate development, logistics, electronics retailing, and media services. Established in 1945, the organization maintains dual headquarters in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, and Dubai, with operations spanning 30 countries and employing approximately 11,000 individuals from over 40 nationalities. The term Abdul Latif Jameel refers to a group of distinct, separate, and independent legal entities, not a single corporate entity or conglomerate. The Role of Mobility Field Specialist Abdul Latif Jameel is seeking a Mobility Field Specialist to join its team in Jeddah and Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role requires 2-5 years of relevant experience and focuses on supporting the development and implementation of training, standards, and operational excellence initiatives across various business units. The specialist will contribute to strengthening associate capabilities and ensuring network readiness through coordinated training activities and performance monitoring. Key Responsibilities Support the development and implementation of training, awareness, and competency-building initiatives for Mobility Standards Excellence (MSE), centers, and wholesalers. Coordinate training activities related to TMC, ALJ, Jameel Standards, Imtithal, safety, policy, and operations, while monitoring participation, certification, knowledge transfer, and training effectiveness. Analyze and monitor Jameel Standards, Imtithal, TMC/ALJ programs, operational KPIs, and compliance performance across Sales, Service, Parts, Used Cars, Body & Paint, centers, and wholesalers. Support standards and SOP development, program piloting, certification, network expansion, performance assurance, and corrective action follow-up through analysis, reports, and recommendations. Collect, validate, analyze, and consolidate operational data to produce performance dashboards, management reports, and actionable insights for data-driven decision-making. Support digital applications and enhancement initiatives for Jameel Standards, Imtithal, RCA/eRCA, estimation, and operational reporting by coordinating business requirements, validating system functionality, and monitoring adoption and data quality. Coordinate with TMC/OEM, Retail, AutoHub, Wholesalers, internal support functions, and other stakeholders to facilitate standards-related communication and program requirements. Monitor and report operational, regulatory, safety, environmental, and business continuity risks, supporting compliance reviews, risk documentation, escalation, and corrective action follow-up. Analyze operational performance gaps and support continuous improvement initiatives using RCA/eRCA, Toyota Business Practice (TBP), PDCA, Kaizen, and best-practice identification. Coordinate progress tracking, reporting, and documentation for TMC and ALJ improvement and recognition programs, including Kaizen Marathon, Distributor Award, Jameel Champions, and relevant quality, safety, and people-development initiatives. Experience Required Candidates for the Mobility Field Specialist position should possess 2-5 years of relevant professional experience. This experience should ideally include exposure to operational standards, training coordination, data analysis, and performance monitoring within a similar industry or a complex business environment. Work Location and Type This is a full-time position based in Jeddah and Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working within a dynamic environment that requires coordination with various internal and external stakeholders across different operational areas.

eec709952c0c4b8c.description: About Synechron Synechron is a global digital transformation consulting and technology services company. The company specializes in helping organizations modernize their businesses through innovative technology, data, and engineering solutions. Synechron provides expertise across banking, financial services, payments, and emerging technologies, working with clients to deliver secure, scalable, and business-focused solutions. The Role of Base EPS Developer Synechron is seeking a Base EPS Developer to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves working with experienced technology professionals on mission-critical payment and banking platforms, collaborating with global teams, and contributing to innovative solutions for leading organizations. The position requires a minimum of 10 years of experience in the field. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, customize, and maintain BASE24/BASE24-eps applications. Configure and support ATM, POS, Acquiring, Issuing, and Payment Switch systems. Develop enhancements using TAL, COBOL, SCOBOL, C, C++, and related technologies. Implement and troubleshoot ISO 8583 message formats and transaction flows. Perform switch integrations with Visa, Mastercard, domestic schemes, and third-party payment systems. Analyze business requirements and prepare technical design documents. Support transaction testing, certification, and migration activities. Monitor production systems and provide Level 2 / Level 3 support. Conduct root cause analysis for transaction failures and performance issues. Collaborate with business, operations, and external vendors during project delivery. Required Experience and Skills Candidates for this role should possess a strong background in BASE24/BASE24-eps development and support, coupled with extensive experience in payment systems. The ability to work effectively with various programming languages and payment protocols is essential. Over 10 years of experience in BASE24/BASE24-eps application development and maintenance. Proficiency in TAL, COBOL, SCOBOL, C, C++, and related development technologies. Demonstrated experience with ATM, POS, Acquiring, Issuing, and Payment Switch configurations. Expertise in ISO 8583 message formats and transaction flow troubleshooting. Experience with integrations involving Visa, Mastercard, domestic schemes, and third-party payment systems. Strong analytical skills for business requirements and technical design documentation. Capability to provide Level 2 / Level 3 production support and perform root cause analysis. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves collaboration with global teams and engagement with leading organizations in the financial services sector.

eec91446d9cbf34c.description: About the Role Hilton is seeking a Housekeeping Supervisor to join its team in Makkah. This full-time role is central to maintaining the hotel's standards of cleanliness and guest satisfaction. The Housekeeping Supervisor is responsible for overseeing housekeeping operations and ensuring a high quality of service for all guests. Role Overview The Housekeeping Supervisor ensures the upkeep and cleanliness of the hotel premises. This position involves delivering memorable experiences for guests by maintaining high standards in guest rooms and public areas. The role requires a focus on operational efficiency and guest service. Key Responsibilities Supervise the housekeeping team, including training, scheduling, and overseeing team members to ensure cleanliness and quality standards in guest rooms. Conduct routine checks of checkout rooms, spot inspections of occupied rooms, and review service areas, storage, and corridors to ensure cleanliness and maintenance standards are met. Report and promptly follow up on any maintenance issues or facility concerns. Schedule and supervise periodic deep cleaning and special housekeeping initiatives. Maintain stock levels and ensure proper maintenance of housekeeping equipment. Ensure excellent service, including managing VIP and special guest requests. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should have 5-10 years of experience in a relevant field. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, within the hospitality industry at Hilton. Application Process Further details regarding the application process and salary will be discussed with qualified candidates.

eed54d3ad60bcef5.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مستشفى الهيئة الملكية بالجبيل عن استشاري أمراض القلب للانضمام إلى فريقها في الجبيل. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تقديم أعلى مستويات الرعاية الطبية للمرضى، بما يتوافق مع الصلاحيات والامتيازات السريرية المعتمدة والموارد المتاحة في المستشفى. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية الالتزام باللوائح المنظمة للكادر الطبي، ومدونة أخلاقيات المهنة، والقواعد والأنظمة الخاصة بالقسم أو الإدارة. تقديم رعاية طبية عالية الجودة للمرضى المسؤول عن علاجهم. تنفيذ جميع المهام السريرية للمرضى المنومين ومراجعي العيادات الخارجية، وفقاً لتوجيهات مدير الإدارة أو رئيس القسم، وبما يتناسب مع الامتيازات السريرية المعتمدة. المشاركة في المناوبات حسب متطلبات القسم أو الإدارة. تدريب الموظفين المكلفين لأغراض التدريب، والمشاركة في ذلك بالتنسيق مع مدير الإدارة أو رئيس القسم والمدير الطبي. المساهمة في تحسين جودة رعاية المرضى من خلال برامج إدارة الجودة الشاملة وتقييم وتحسين الجودة. تثقيف المرضى وذويهم حول الخطة العلاجية والتدبير الطبي للحالة. السعي لتطوير الخبرات والمهارات السريرية، والارتقاء بالممارسة المهنية مع مراعاة معدلات الإصابة بالأمراض وفعالية التكلفة. المشاركة في التخطيط المستقبلي والتطوير المستمر للقسم أو الإدارة. تنفيذ أي مهام أو واجبات أخرى ذات صلة ضمن نطاق المعرفة والمهارات المهنية، سواء داخل المستشفى أو في المنشآت الطبية التابعة له. المؤهلات والخبرات يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة في مجال أمراض القلب، مع القدرة على تقديم رعاية طبية متكاملة. يجب أن يكون المرشح حاصلاً على الصلاحيات والامتيازات السريرية اللازمة لممارسة المهنة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات سريرية وتشخيصية متقدمة في أمراض القلب. القدرة على التواصل الفعال مع المرضى وذويهم. الالتزام بالمعايير الأخلاقية والمهنية العالية. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق متعدد التخصصات. مهارات التدريب والتوجيه للموظفين الجدد. بيئة العمل يعمل استشاري أمراض القلب في مستشفى الهيئة الملكية بالجبيل، وهي منشأة طبية ملتزمة بتقديم رعاية صحية متطورة. يتطلب الدور العمل بدوام كامل والمشاركة في المناوبات حسب الحاجة لضمان استمرارية الرعاية. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور في مستشفى الهيئة الملكية بالجبيل.

eedd6fc10f2e287f.description: About Mace Group Mace Group integrates construction expertise with consultancy services to enhance project potential and redefine ambitious goals. The company's values guide its consulting approach and define the professionals it seeks to join its teams. Mace is a delivery partner on a significant program in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, which involves a major mixed-use development encompassing sports facilities, entertainment, arts, and associated infrastructure. The Role: BIM Manager Mace Group is seeking a BIM Manager to join its team in Riyadh. This part-time role involves leading integrated teams throughout various project phases within one of Saudi Arabia's largest programs. The BIM Manager will be responsible for managing BIM and digital information requirements across assigned districts, projects, and work packages, ensuring compliance with established standards and processes. Key Responsibilities Manage BIM and Digital Information requirements across assigned MDU districts, projects, and work packages. Ensure compliance with Qiddiya BIM Standards and ISO 19650 processes, including reviewing BEPs, MIDPs, TIDPs, and key deliverables. Provide BIM expertise for stage-gate submissions, governance reviews, and leadership reporting. Oversee federated model coordination, clash detection, issue resolution, and Levels of Information Need using Navisworks, Revizto, or equivalent tools. Lead BIM quality assurance, covering modeling standards, classification, georeferencing, metadata, and model health. Support CDE governance through Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC), including workflows, approvals, permissions, revision control, and information exchange. Review and validate multidisciplinary models using Revit, Civil 3D, AutoCAD, and other Autodesk AEC tools. Monitor consultant performance, deliverables, and milestones, identifying risks and corrective actions. Produce BIM compliance and digital performance reports for senior leadership and governance panels. Support BIM and GIS integration to ensure coordinated and georeferenced information across the portfolio. Provide technical leadership to consultants, contractors, delivery partners, and internal teams. Drive improvements in digital standards, automation, reporting, and workflows while supporting junior BIM team members. Company Values Mace Group operates on core values that include Safety first, emphasizing a safe, diverse, and inclusive working environment; Client focus, ensuring delivery on promises and building long-term relationships; Integrity, upholding ethical practices and compliance; and Create opportunity, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and professional development for its people.
